How it works

Three Steps. One Shade.

Colorwash cleanses and deposits color in one step. Colorditioner conditions and refreshes it. BondFix rebuilds broken bonds, and the Color-Lock System helps prevent fading. Pick your shade family and start there.

Colorwash

Cleanse + Color

The original color-depositing shampoo. Viral Colorwash cleanses and deposits rich, even color in one step, in shades like Light Pink and Rose Gold.

Colorditioner

Condition + Refresh

Viral Colorditioner with BondFix conditions while it refreshes your shade between Colorwash days, so the color never gets a day off.

BondFix

Rebuild + Strengthen

BondFix Strengthening Conditioner rebuilds broken bonds in bleached, lightened, and fragile hair. Color is only luxurious when the hair under it is strong.

CelebPro Styling

Finish + Shine

The salon finish, bottled. OPTIC Shine Oil and BLOWN Blow Dry Balm close the routine the way a stylist would: smooth, glossy, done.

The Color-Lock System

Every Celeb Luxury formula is built on the Color-Lock System, made to help prevent fading, so the shade you deposit is the shade that stays. Vegan, cruelty free, and salon-tested, from the first wash on.
